name: UJN catheter drive
full_name: University of Jinan compact continuous-delivery catheter drive with friction wheels in a disposable surgical box and a constant-force clamp
group: School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Jinan (Tianxiao Cao, Rongyu Ge [corresponding], Yi Zhang, Wenlong Wang) (cao2024_cathdrive, affiliation lines)
versions: single version (cao2024_cathdrive, IDITR 2024); Alekseeva 2025 Table 10 lists a design by the same authors (W. Wang et al. 2024, clamping bracket block) as TRL2 concept, not catalogued
target_anatomy: N.R. (general vascular intervention; coronary, brain, liver and kidney lesions named in the introduction)
devices_driven: one catheter (Sec. II); tests with a catheter (Figs. 13-14)
translation_detail: friction-roller: two active and two driven grooved friction wheels in a disposable box, the active ones driven through three gear shafts by one motor; the box couples to the power unit by a triangular-prism shaft (Sec. II-A1, II-B, Figs. 2, 4, 7)
rotation_detail: gear pair rotates the whole axial-feed unit, the feed motor rides along, wires through a conductive slip ring (Sec. II-A2, Fig. 3)
device_range: N.R. (constant-force clamp adjustable by spring pre-compression, Sec. II-B, III)
force_sensing: none (a sawtooth constant-force clamp caps the clamping force mechanically, Sec. II-B, III)
haptics_leader: a "master manipulator" box stands on the bench in the platform photo (Fig. 12); its design is N.R.; the tests were run from upper-computer software (Sec. V)
sterility: disposable surgical box holds every part that touches the catheter; reusable power unit below (Sec. II-B, Fig. 5)
validation_detail: bench: 10 axial moves of 100 mm measured with a vernier caliper and 10 rotations of 60 deg measured with a protractor on the experimental platform (Sec. V, Figs. 12-14); no phantom. Alekseeva 2025 Table 9 lists it as TRL3 (ex vivo phantom).
key_numbers: axial error -0.65 to +0.62 mm per 100 mm move; rotation error -2 to +2 deg per 60 deg (Sec. V); calculated: 19.72 mm per feed-motor turn, max feed speed 3845.39 mm/s, 0.05 rad per rotation-motor turn, max rotation speed printed as 6.42 rad/s in Eq. 11 and 6.24 rad/s in the text (Sec. IV); friction wheel radius 14.5 mm; feed motor 11,700 rpm with reducer 4.62; rotation motor 7,600 rpm with reducer 62.01 and gear ratio 2:1 (Sec. IV)
